description: This file contains functions and classes for handling metadata extraction and embedding for media files, utilizing external libraries and schemas. It defines functions to extract metadata based on media type, embed metadata into media files, and a custom metadata class with validation and trimming features.

classes.name: IsccMeta
classes.description: A custom metadata class extending iss.IsccMeta with additional validation and support for nested parts.

methods.name: extract_metadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata from a media file based on its type.

methods.name: embed_metadata
methods.description: Embeds metadata into a media file and returns the path to the new file.

methods.name: trim_name
methods.description: Validator that trims the 'name' field in metadata.

methods.name: trim_description
methods.description: Validator that trims the 'description' field in metadata.
